sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Our iOS builds waited three times longer than they ran, on a pool of five Macs.
sections.para: One Mac job per push, then one integrated build an hour, brought push to TestFlight under half an hour.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Macs not agents, ten Macs per push, measured and rebuilt, flooded again, where it stands.

sections.label: Part five of ten days
sections.line: Part five of the Ten days series, after native apps by agents.

sections.label: What I could see
sections.line: On 10 November I saw that allocating Macs was the bottleneck and asked for fewer steps and publishing from dev.
sections.para: An agent was asked to measure it.

sections.label: What the agent measured
sections.line: 579 runs: 6,980 Mac-minutes run, 22,427 queued; the five-Mac pool full most of the time.
sections.para: A median of ten macOS jobs per dev push; 47.5 minutes to TestFlight.

sections.label: Six reasons for the wait
sections.line: Separate Macs per step, cold starts, sequential stages, untested uploads, idle Macs, side branches.
sections.para: 821 jobs cancelled before they got a Mac.

sections.label: One Mac per push
sections.line: All Mac work in one job: build, test on iPhone and iPad, publish only when green.
sections.para: Build before booting simulators; a generic simulator destination; one shared build folder.

sections.label: Then it flooded again
sections.line: On 15 November the runners flooded again; the fix was a rule: one integrated build an hour.
sections.para: Night builds from about 35 minutes to about 7.

sections.label: Where it stands
sections.line: A live CI status page; push to processed in TestFlight in about 20 to 25 minutes.
sections.para: Seven news app builds overnight; larger runners still to decide.

sections.label: What it taught us
sections.line: Shared machines do not scale with agents; measure first; fewer jobs; rules; show the number.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: The agent's measurements, two after runs, the conductor's approximate night notes, no pricing.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The iOS repository's briefs, commits and workflows, and the live CI status page.
